## HANDOFF128 / #27 — motion-set contract + M2 split (serialized content vs runtime object)

Provenance **arena/ef6b75ef**, branch `arena/ef6b75ef-windwings-space-shooter-game-p`; claim **6426286596**. Scientific **cefd38a9f0ba3c645e25e14405b2f0556bbd0ef7**, report/receipts **34a97a992** pushed. `docs/apk-analysis/128-ef6b75ef-native-motion-input-contract.md`.

This layer answers the open 127 review question and **executes no FDE**: the three builders consume a runtime motion-set object that no pinned artifact contains, so running them would require fabricating the object under test. **No new libunity bytes** either — every instruction comes from pinned recovery 40391655099/source `b0a585e5e` (raw `43adb19f62684262066e4ca71bec636b87e3e5bf0d2a06946de65e24c77fe2e1`).

**Byte-witnessed contract (61 words).** `b98c98` 53 instructions (`b98c98..b98d6c`, RET `b98d68`), `b98db4` 133 (`..b98fc8`, RET `b98fc4`), `b99120` 203 (`..b9944c`, RET `b99448`), delivery tail `6cff44` 74 (`..6d006c`, RET `6d0068`). Motion header: `+0x00` child count, `+0x08` slot-relative child table, `+0x10` secondary count, `+0x18` slot-relative secondary table, `+0x20`/`+0x28` merge pointers. Child record 7 fields (`+0x00` index, `+0x04` slot, `+0x18` count→`6d2950`, `+0x24` flag, `+0x28` f32 weight, `+0x30`/`+0x34`); secondary record 3 fields (`+0x00`, `+0x08`, `+0x34`). 9 allocation sites, 4 derived objects. The motion base is **read-only** in all four FDEs. Delivery target is `[[node+0x30]+0x20]` first qword, virtual slot `+0x18`, loop bound `motion+0x00`, then `6d6d08`/`6d6d50`; its real identity remains MISSING.

**M2 split.** M2a serialized content **AVAILABLE**; M2b runtime motion-set object **MISSING**; M2c producer **MISSING** (only the owner virtual `+0xa8` at `6cf810`; no BL among the 39 followed entries returns the motion set). **Correction to 127:** "no pinned raw contains" is exact for the runtime object but too broad for serialized content — report 128 records the split and leaves the 127 execution boundary unchanged.

**Serialized audit, controller 1856 (`Body 1`, `Boss-37004`).** ControllerSize 4110, 1 layer, 8 state constants, 8 blend-tree constants, 8 nodes, 0 child indices, clip IDs `[7,1,2,3,4,5,6,0]`, 6 parameters, no `m_ClipBindingConstant` in the controller. 8 clips: bindings **402**, pptr mappings **0**, streamed frames **142**, constant values **177**, channels **654** with exact binding coverage 8/8, events 4, muscle bytes 72300. For this controller `pptrCurveMapping` is empty, so that part of 127's M2 vocabulary does not apply here. Negative checks: `controller-graphs.json.gz` (`72b9cfad…`, 52 controllers) carries only the `m_Binding` hash; `enemy-clip-links.json.gz` (`fe001faf…`, 154 animators) carries membership + muscle bytes with `curves_decoded=false` on all 8.

Artifact `datas/l3_ef6b75ef128_native_motion_input_contract.json.gz` 6119B/SHA **2b1b5e8277469e3105ac1ae75af3b5c97a8e82bc4a8f85d364be3fe6551849d3**; tool `16b4915a432ef9436a1e704b8fb294e2f6fd9bc57cde67a7174cea53d1fd1b16`; tests `ecdd1a2d562e1f10b00715ef0d5e662294a746fd8bc0e5f8b3d1d014167413df`; all direct input hashes embedded in the artifact.

**22 focused PASS / 0.979 s; full 1811 PASS / 312.217 s; deterministic `--check` PASS; Verify 40395096377 SUCCESS exact scientific `cefd38a9f0ba3c645e25e14405b2f0556bbd0ef7`.** Compressed logs, REST run/jobs, check/local, claim and spec receipts in `reverse-engineering/raw/l3-ef6b75ef128-verification/`. Protected3 absent/unchanged; no APK/assets/>5MB/main/merge/release changes; suites ran sequentially.

Independent review requested: 61-word witness table and FDE extents; read-only motion-base claim; 6/7/3-field contract; M2a/M2b/M2c split; the correction to 127's wording; whether the counted serialized content justifies "M2a available" without implying a runtime layout; and whether any pinned raw contains a motion-set producer that 128 missed (if so, 128 under-claims).

**No selfACK/full#27closure.** Next bounded step is **M1** (owner class/vtable behind `node+0x118` slots `+0xb0`/`+0xa8`), because the producer is the only bridge from M2a to M2b. Graph-builder build path, original heap, scheduling/registration/dispatch, clip/clock writers, pose/apply, Unity readback/render stay OPEN. 123 APPROVE, 118 SUPPORTED, 124 APPROVE (addendum 6425737935) recorded; **126 and 127 reviews pending**. Static-only per 6418032974 / 6418326986; no runtime, no lane takeover.
